name: Seer
epithet: The one who reads what is already written
description: A pathway of divination, misdirection and worn faces. Its powers answer questions rather than win fights — which is why it suits a private investigator, and why a Seer who reaches for violence is usually already lost.

sequences.title: Seer
sequences.description: You can ask the world a question and get an answer, provided the question is small and you do not mind the answer being crooked. It is not much. It is enough to notice what a careful man would have missed.
sequences.narrative: You drank it in a rented room with the curtains drawn, and for a week afterwards every deck of cards you passed felt like it was watching you back.

requirements.label: Learn the name of the rung above you
Close a case for the Nighthawks
Obtain the Clown formula (requisitioned, or a copy)
Obtain the Clown potion
Digest the Seer potion — act the part in public

advancement.ritualText: Blackthorn’s cellar room smells of candle fat and old paper. You mark the circle yourself, because the Fool insists that a rite performed by somebody else is somebody else’s rite. Then you drink.

temptation.label: Drink it now, and let the role catch up
temptation.description: The potion is in your hand. You are not finished being a Seer, and it will notice.

sequences.title: Clown
sequences.description: Hands quicker than the eye that follows them, and a knack for being looked away from. The Clown gets into rooms. Getting out is a separate skill, and one the pathway is happy to sell you later.
sequences.narrative: You laugh at something that is not funny and cannot stop for eleven seconds. Afterwards your hands know things they were not taught, and a locked drawer feels like a rude question.

requirements.label: Draw a crowd’s laughter, and mean none of it
Obtain the Magician formula
Obtain the Magician potion
Dunn Smith must vouch for you
Digest the Clown potion

advancement.ritualText: Old Neil reads the formula aloud twice, the second time slower, watching your face for the place where you stop listening. You do not give him one.

temptation.label: Skip the vouching. Drink.
temptation.description: The Club’s blessing is a formality, and formalities are for people with time.

sequences.title: Magician
sequences.description: Props out of nothing, presence out of posture. The Magician makes people believe a thing is true for exactly as long as the trick needs, which is a considerable power in a room with a magistrate in it.
sequences.narrative: You produce a warrant from an empty coat and the constable reads it carefully, and it says what he expects it to say. You keep the coat. You do not look in the pocket again for a month.

requirements.label: Perform an impossible thing before witnesses
Obtain the Faceless formula
Obtain the Faceless potion
Digest the Magician potion

advancement.ritualText: There is no circle for this one. The Fool’s instruction is a single line: be no one, thoroughly, for as long as it takes.

temptation.label: Wear it before it fits
temptation.description: A face that is not yours, on a self that has not finished being yours.

sequences.title: Faceless
sequences.description: You can be someone else entirely — their face, their voice, the particular way they hold a cup. The Club’s records note, without comment, that Sequence 6 Seers have the highest rate of forgetting which face was the original.
sequences.narrative: You take off a face and there is a moment — a short one, you tell yourself — where you cannot remember what goes underneath.

requirements.label: Take what the sea leaves on the altar
Obtain the Marionettist formula
Obtain the Marionettist potion
Digest the potion you are already carrying

advancement.ritualText: The faces you have worn are laid out like a hand of cards, and you pick the one that is least you. The potion goes down while you are wearing it, so that whatever it changes, it changes somebody else.

temptation.label: Wear a face you have not earned
temptation.description: Take the rite half-digested, in a borrowed face. It will hold. It is holding it afterwards that costs.

sequences.title: Marionettist
sequences.description: Strings, and the habit of seeing them. A Marionettist can move what has stopped moving, and is expected to have a very clear idea of why he wants to.
sequences.narrative: You notice, walking through a crowd, that you have started counting the threads. Nobody is holding them. That is not the same as nobody being able to.

requirements.label: Learn what it costs a man not to die
Obtain the Bizarro Sorcerer formula
Obtain the Bizarro Sorcerer potion
Digest the potion you are already carrying

advancement.ritualText: Threads first, then the potion. A Marionettist who drinks before he has hold of his own strings finds out whose hand is on them, and it is a short discovery.

temptation.label: Drink before the threads are set
temptation.description: Faster, and it works, and for a week you will not be certain which of your own movements you decided on.

sequences.title: Bizarro Sorcerer
sequences.description: A demigod, in the language the Church uses when it is being careful. Places, names and events become things you can exchange for one another, provided you can pay the difference.
sequences.narrative: Somewhere between the third exchange and the fourth, you stop asking whether the world minds.

requirements.label: Take Saint Selena’s ashes back off the man who took them
Obtain the Scholar of Yore formula
Obtain the Scholar of Yore potion
Digest the potion you are already carrying

advancement.ritualText: Two mysteries are laid side by side and told to change places. One of them is you. The rite is over when the swap does not swap back.

temptation.label: Swap without a second mystery
temptation.description: Use your own two halves as the pair. It saves a fortnight of hunting and costs something you will not be able to name afterwards.

sequences.title: Scholar of Yore
sequences.description: History stops being a thing that happened and becomes a room you may enter, provided you knock. Ask a wall what it stood through and it will tell you, at the usual price: what you are told, you were also there for.
sequences.narrative: You woke knowing the name of the mason who cut the step outside your door, and how he died, and that he had been thinking about his daughter at the time. None of it was any use. All of it was true.

requirements.label: Look back at the man who performed the ritual
Obtain the Miracle Invoker formula
Obtain the Miracle Invoker potion
Digest the Scholar of Yore potion

advancement.ritualText: The rite is read out of a book that was read out of another book, back and back until the first hand is a rumour. That is the whole of it: the Scholar of Yore does not learn the past. He is admitted to it.

temptation.label: Read it out of the wrong book
temptation.description: A copy of a copy, and the errors in it are load-bearing. It will still admit you. It will admit other things at the same time.

sequences.title: Miracle Invoker
sequences.description: You may ask for a thing to be otherwise, and sometimes it is. Not often, never twice the same way, and never without a bill arriving later made out to somebody — occasionally you.
sequences.narrative: You asked, out loud, in an empty room, for one small impossible thing. It happened. You sat down afterwards and did not ask for anything else for a fortnight.

requirements.label: Die in the Corpse Cathedral, by arrangement
Obtain the Attendant of Mysteries formula
Obtain the Attendant of Mysteries potion
Digest the Miracle Invoker potion

advancement.ritualText: A miracle is a thing asked for and granted, and the asking is the difficult half. You lay out the circle, and for the first time the circle is not a formality: something on the other side of it is listening for the request.

temptation.label: Ask before the circle is closed
temptation.description: The request goes out through a gap. Something answers it that was not the thing you addressed.

sequences.title: Attendant of Mysteries
sequences.description: The King of Angels. Every mystery on this pathway attends on you now, which sounds like service and is in fact surveillance: you are the thing they gather around, and you cannot put them down.
sequences.narrative: Sequence 1. The King of Angels, with a chair above the fog and a name four people say aloud on Sunday nights, and underneath it a man from Tingen who still counts his change.

sequences.title: The Fool
sequences.potionName: None. There is no potion for a uniqueness
sequences.description: Sequence 0 is not a rank but a seat, and it is already occupied, and the occupant is a story people tell about a grey fog and a bronze long table. Book One does not reach it.
